description:
Named for the courage and precision of the fighter pilots who ruled the skies, the Valor™ stands as the most versatile, purposeful, and relentlessly capable road bike ever engineered in titanium. Born from Airborne’s uncompromising dedication to precision manufacturing and decades of real-world performance testing, this flagship platform is purpose-built to dominate every road mission — from blistering UCI-level races on closed circuits to long-haul endurance rides and supremely stable credit-card touring or fast-packing adventures across continents. With its revolutionary geometry range and titanium’s legendary ride quality, the Valor™ doesn’t just adapt to the road — it masters it.

Equipped with the groundbreaking patent-pending RideDNA™ adjustable headset system and the VectorLoc™ adjustable dropout system, the Airborne Valor lets you instantly transform its character — from a razor-sharp, short-wheelbase race weapon to a plush, long-distance endurance machine or a confidence-inspiring all-road explorer with the simple turn of a wrench.

Key features:

Helix ™ adjustable headset system — modify head tube angle for optimized stability, agility, or all-terrain confidence. Adjust to match your preferred riding style.

VectorLoc ™ adjustable dropout system — 6 positions let you tune chainstay length, tire clearance, and frame geometry, delivering the perfect balance for any mission.

Phantom DLC ™ Hyper Black Lifetime Scratch Proof Coating

Premium double-butted 3Al-2.5V titanium tubing construction — natural compliance, superior vibration damping, and lifetime durability.

Advanced hydroformed titanium T/T and D/T — precisely engineered shapes for superior stiffness where you need it, compliance where you want it, and a strikingly modern, aggressive aesthetic.

SLM 3D Printed Grade 5 (6Al/4V) Titanium, Vacuum Annealed frame components: Hyperbolic Paraboloid Head Tube, VectorLoc™ Dropouts

Generous tire clearance — Competition 32mm Tires @ 408mm Chain Stay length to 45mm road or gravel tires @ 433mm.

For riders who refuse to choose between pure speed and real-world versatility, the Valor™ is more than a road bike — it is the definitive titanium road weapon that redefines what’s possible in modern performance cycling. One platform. Every road.
